description.text: Objectives The PhD program in Electronic & Information Engineering provides students with solid theory and the latest technological knowledge. Students will have a broad choice on the research topics in telecommunication engineering, signal and system, biomedical engineering, integrated circuits, optical communications, and micro/nano photonics. Students will acquire the latest technical know-how by engaging in specialized subjects in a chosen area that focus on the cutting edge issues. After the program, students are expected to engage in high level scientific research, and assume leadership role in their related fields. Duration Duration of program is between 3-4 years with course works in the first year, followed by a dissertation project. Research Areas 1. Communication and Information Theory 2. Signal Processing 3. Biomedical Engineering 4. Wireless Communications and Networking 5. Solid-state Electronics & Photonics Credit Units Students need to successfully complete minimum 14 credits, among which 10 must be core courses, 3 must be elective courses, and 1 must be academic report. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship

duration.text: The Information and Communication Engineering at Harbin Institute of Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5833 USD/per year ￥ 42000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. HITSZ International Student Application Form 2. Highest degree (notarized photocopy) 3. Academic transcripts (notarized photocopy) 4. A study plan (no less than 800 words) 5. Three recommendation letters 6. Photocopy of your Identification Certificate 7. Three passport photos

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 3. Hold a Master's degree.
